dialogue.content: こんにちは、本日よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello, I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: お手数おかけしてすみません。今回のクライエントの設定を「中高生」でお願いしてもよろしいでしょうか？ケースは問いません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry to trouble you. Could I ask you to set the client as a 'middle or high school student' for this session? Any case is fine.

dialogue.content: はい、承知しました。お願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, understood. Let's do that.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。お時間になりましたら開始いたしますね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. We'll begin when it's time.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。相談ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Hello, this is the counselor. Thank you for reaching out.

dialogue.content: 最初に年齢、性別、呼んで欲しい名前をお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: First, may I ask your age, gender, and the name you'd like to be called?

dialogue.content: 14歳女子　はな
dialogue.English: 14 years old, female, Hana.

dialogue.content: 教えていただきありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that with me.

dialogue.content: 本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 親、うざい
dialogue.English: My parents are so annoying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、、しんどいですよね、、
dialogue.English: I see... That must be tough...

dialogue.content: 差し支えなければ親とどのようなことがありましたか？
dialogue.English: If you don't mind sharing, could you tell me what's been happening with your parents?

dialogue.content: 早く風呂入れ、とか、早く、ご飯にして、とか、勉強しろ、とか、うざい
dialogue.English: Like, "Hurry up and take a bath," or "Hurry up and eat," or "Go study." It's so annoying.

dialogue.content: 毎日言ってくる、うざい
dialogue.English: They say it every day. It's annoying.

dialogue.content: 毎日言ってくるんですね、、急かされるのはイライラしちゃいますよね。。
dialogue.English: They say that every day... It must be frustrating to be rushed all the time.

dialogue.content: 誰と話してたの、とか、いちいち干渉してくる
dialogue.English: And they're always interfering, asking things like, "Who were you talking to?"

dialogue.content: 干渉も、、窮屈に感じちゃいますね、、
dialogue.English: That kind of interference... it must feel suffocating...

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: うざいと感じた時にはなさんは今までどんなことで解消してきましたか？
dialogue.English: When you feel annoyed, what have you been doing so far to cope, Hana?

dialogue.content: ラインとか、ゲームとか
dialogue.English: Like LINE or games.

dialogue.content: そうだったんですね。はなさんなりに考えたんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. It sounds like you've found your own ways to deal with it.

dialogue.content: だから、また怒られる
dialogue.English: But then I get scolded again for that.

dialogue.content: そんな、、ストレス解消しているのに気が休まらないですよね、、
dialogue.English: Oh... so even when you're trying to relieve stress, you can't really relax...

dialogue.content: うざい
dialogue.English: It's so annoying.

dialogue.content: うんうんそうだよね。そう感じるのも自然なことだと思います。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, that makes sense. It's natural to feel that way.

dialogue.content: ちなみに急かすことを言うのは両親からですか？
dialogue.English: By the way, is it both of your parents who rush you like that?

dialogue.content: お母さん
dialogue.English: My mom.

dialogue.content: お母さんなんだね。
dialogue.English: So it's your mom.

dialogue.content: うるさい、ほっといてほしい
dialogue.English: She's so nagging. I wish she'd just leave me alone.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。毎日言われたらそれは嫌にもなりますよね。。
dialogue.English: I see. If you hear that every day, it's understandable you'd get tired of it.

dialogue.content: 今日の相談でどんなことを解決したいですか？
dialogue.English: What would you like to achieve from our session today?

dialogue.content: なんで勉強なんか、しなくちゃいけないんですか？
dialogue.English: Why do I even have to study?

dialogue.content: そのように考えているんですね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you're thinking about it.

dialogue.content: 勉強なんかしたって、やりたいこともない
dialogue.English: Even if I study, I don't even have anything I want to do.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: そのように考えているんだね。そのように思うのもおかしくはないと思う。
dialogue.English: I see that's how you're thinking. I don't think it's strange to feel that way.

dialogue.content: やっぱり、しなくてもいいですよね
dialogue.English: So it's okay if I don't, right?

dialogue.content: そう考えいるんだね。
dialogue.English: That's what you're thinking.

dialogue.content: ここまで少し話を整理しても良いかな？
dialogue.English: Would it be okay if I summarized what we've talked about so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はなさんはお母さんから毎日早く風呂やご飯や勉強などを急かされる。
dialogue.English: So, Hana, your mother rushes you every day about taking a bath, eating, and studying.

dialogue.content: それに対してうるさくてほっといてほしいと思っている
dialogue.English: You feel that it's annoying and you wish she would leave you alone.

dialogue.content: LINEやゲームで解消してもまた怒られて結局イライラしてしまう
dialogue.English: Even when you try to de-stress with LINE or games, you get scolded again, which just ends up making you more frustrated.

dialogue.content: さらにはやりたいことがないのに勉強しても意味がないのになぜやらないといけないのかと考えている。
dialogue.English: On top of that, since you don't have anything you want to do, you're wondering why you have to study when it feels meaningless.

dialogue.content: こんな感じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound about right?

dialogue.content: はい、なんで勉強なんて、しなきゃいけないの？
dialogue.English: Yes. Why do I even have to study?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。そう思いますよね。
dialogue.English: Thank you. It's understandable to feel that way.

dialogue.content: 勉強しなくちゃいけないと思ったきっかけって親から言われたから？
dialogue.English: What made you think you have to study? Was it because your parents told you to?

dialogue.content: う～ん、それもあるし、義務教育。でしょ。
dialogue.English: Hmm, that's part of it, and also, it's compulsory education, right?

dialogue.content: うんうんそうなんだね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm, I see.

dialogue.content: しなきゃいけないってことでしょ
dialogue.English: So it's something I have to do, right?

dialogue.content: そのように感じているんだね。
dialogue.English: That's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: ちなみにクラスの同級生や友達はどう思っているか聞いてみた？
dialogue.English: By the way, have you asked your classmates or friends what they think?

dialogue.content: 聴いてみてはいないけど、みんなもあんまり勉強してないみたい
dialogue.English: I haven't asked, but it seems like most of them aren't studying much either.

dialogue.content: だから、ライン
dialogue.English: That's why we're on LINE.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。ちなみにラインではどんな話するの？（話せる範囲で良いですよ）
dialogue.English: I see. By the way, what do you talk about on LINE? (You only have to share what you're comfortable with.)

dialogue.content: 好きなアイドルの事とか、ドラマ
dialogue.English: Our favorite idols, dramas, things like that.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm.

dialogue.content: そんなLINEをしているんだね。
dialogue.English: So that's what you talk about on LINE.

dialogue.content: 話している時ははなさんの気持ちはどんな感じ？
dialogue.English: How do you feel when you're talking about those things, Hana?

dialogue.content: キャ～♡ってなる
dialogue.English: I get all excited ♡.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ！楽しい？
dialogue.English: Really! Is it fun?

dialogue.content: 流星命、萌音ちゃん、かわいい
dialogue.English: I'm all about Ryusei—Moene-chan is so cute.

dialogue.content: 推してる子がいるんだね。
dialogue.English: So you have favorites you're a fan of.

dialogue.content: うん。グッズとかもニコイチ
dialogue.English: Yeah. We even have matching merch.

dialogue.content: そうなんだ。好きなものがあると嬉しいよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It's great to have something you're passionate about, isn't it?

dialogue.content: ここまで話を聴いて感じたことをお話ししても良いかな？
dialogue.English: Can I share what I've felt from listening so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はなさんははなさんなりに行動していることは素敵なことだと思う。
dialogue.English: I think it's wonderful that you are doing things in your own way, Hana.

dialogue.content: お母さんが勉強について急かすのももしかするとはなさんの将来を思っての言動かもしれない。
dialogue.English: It's possible that when your mother rushes you about studying, her words might be coming from a place of concern for your future.

dialogue.content: でもはなさんが勉強はやる必要があるのか？と思うのも全く不思議ではないと思う。
dialogue.English: At the same time, it's completely understandable that you wonder whether you need to study.

dialogue.content: もし嫌じゃなければ一度母親に思い切って勉強をやる意味について聞いてみてもどうかと思ったけどどうかな？
dialogue.English: If you're not against it, I was thinking you could try asking your mother directly about the meaning of studying. What do you think about that?

dialogue.content: 聞いてるけど、意味わからん
dialogue.English: I've asked, but I don't get it.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。どんなところが意味わからないと思った？
dialogue.English: Oh, you have. What part of it did you find hard to understand?

dialogue.content: 一部でも良いよ
dialogue.English: Even just a small part is fine.

dialogue.content: ただやればいいの、やりなさい、としか言わないもん
dialogue.English: She just says things like, "You just have to do it," or "Just do it."

dialogue.content: そうだったんだね。。ただやれだけ言われてもそう感じるのも仕方のないことだと思う。
dialogue.English: I see... If that's all she says, I can understand why you'd feel that way.

dialogue.content: 先程やりたいことが見つからないから勉強しても意味がないと思ってたけど
dialogue.English: Earlier, you mentioned that you feel studying is meaningless because you haven't found anything you want to do.

dialogue.content: やりたいことをどうやって見つけたかを聞いてみるのも一つかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: Maybe it could be helpful to ask her how she found what she wanted to do.

dialogue.content: お母さんに？
dialogue.English: Ask my mom?

dialogue.content: うんうん。もしくはお父さんだったり話せる大人だったりでも良いと思う。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. Or maybe your dad, or any adult you feel comfortable talking to.

dialogue.content: 大人は、やりたいことをやっているの？
dialogue.English: Are adults doing things they want to do?

dialogue.content: そんな風に見えないんです
dialogue.English: It doesn't look that way to me.

dialogue.content: そう感じてるんだね。
dialogue.English: That's how it seems to you.

dialogue.content: 実はそろそろ時間が来てしまったんだけど、今後も勉強をする意味とかをはなさんと一緒に考えていきたいと思う。
dialogue.English: Actually, we're almost out of time, but I'd like to continue thinking about the meaning of studying with you in the future, Hana.

dialogue.content: なのでまた相談に来て欲しいなと思います。
dialogue.English: So I hope you'll come back to talk again.

dialogue.content: また、来ていいんですか？
dialogue.English: Is it okay for me to come back?

dialogue.content: もちろんです。
dialogue.English: Of course.

dialogue.content: じゃ、そうします
dialogue.English: Okay, I'll do that.

dialogue.content: はい。はなさんにとってとても大事なことだと思うのでいつでも相談お待ちします。
dialogue.English: Yes. I think this is very important for you, so I'll be here whenever you'd like to talk.

dialogue.content: 今日しんどい気持ちの中お話ししてくれてありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you for talking with me today, especially when you're feeling so much distress.

dialogue.content: はい、変なこときいて、すみませんでした
dialogue.English: Okay... I'm sorry for asking strange questions.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、相談に変なということはありません。
dialogue.English: Not at all—there's no such thing as a 'weird' question in counseling.

dialogue.content: はなさんは何も悪くないよ。
dialogue.English: You haven't done anything wrong, Hana.

dialogue.content: 今日相談に来てくれたことをきっかけにはなさんの気持ちが晴れるよう応援しています。
dialogue.English: I hope that coming in today can be a step toward you feeling lighter, and I'm rooting for you.

dialogue.content: また来ます。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: I'll come again. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: ではそろそろ終了いたしますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: We'll wrap up here for today. Thank you.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: （ロープレありがとうございました。それとクライエント設定もありがとうございました。また機会あればよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for the role-play. And thank you for the client setup as well. I hope we can do this again sometime.)

dialogue.content: （では終了いたします。お疲れ様でした！）
dialogue.English: (We'll conclude here. Great job!)

dialogue.content: （こちらこそ、ありがとうございました。とても良い勉強になりました。）
dialogue.English: (Thank you as well. It was a great learning experience.)
